Running the Admin Server Locally

The HCTM Content Management Server runs locally on your computer. To start the admin dashboard, open your terminal and run:

npm run admin

Once running, access the dashboard at http://localhost:4000/

Default login password: hctm2026 (configurable via ADMIN_PASSWORD environment variable).
